{α : Type*} [Fintype α] (M : Matroid α) (hrank : M.eRank = 3) (e f : α) (he : e ∈ M.E) (hf : f ∈ M.E) (hef : e ≠ f) (x : α → ℝ) (hx : ∀ a ∈ M.E, 0 < x a) :
  0 ≤ MvPolynomial.eval x (x2611_15512_rayleigh_difference (x2611_15512_set_polynomial M.IsBase) e f)
closed: ∀ {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (M : Matroid α) (hrank : M.eRank = 3) (e f : α) (he : e ∈ M.E) (hf : f ∈ M.E) (hef : e ≠ f) (x : α → ℝ) (hx : ∀ a ∈ M.E, 0 < x a), 0 ≤ MvPolynomial.eval x (x2611_15512_rayleigh_difference (x2611_15512_set_polynomial M.IsBase) e f)
original:
For every rank- $3$ matroid $M$ , every pair of distinct elements $e,f$ 
and every $x>0$ , $(\Delta_{e,f}B_{M})(x)\geq 0$ .
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] (M : Matroid α), M.eRank = 3 → ∀ (e f : α), e ∈ M.E → f ∈ M.E → e ≠ f → ∀ (x : α → ℝ), (∀ a ∈ M.E, 0 < x a) → 0 ≤ (MvPolynomial.eval x) (Mathlib2.x2611_15512_rayleigh_difference (Mathlib2.x2611_15512_set_polynomial M.IsBase) e f)

theorem x2611_15512_thm2_1_aux1 {α : Type*}
    (p : MvPolynomial α ℝ) (hp : ∀ d, 0 ≤ p.coeff d)
    (x : α → ℝ) (hx : ∀ a ∈ p.vars, 0 ≤ x a) :
    0 ≤ MvPolynomial.eval x p := by
  classical
  rw [MvPolynomial.eval_eq]
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro d hd
  apply mul_nonneg (hp d)
  apply Finset.prod_nonneg
  intro a ha
  exact pow_nonneg (hx a (MvPolynomial.support_subset_vars_of_mem_support hd ha)) _

theorem x2611_15512_thm2_1_aux2 {α ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (p c : MvPolynomial α ℝ) (q : ι → MvPolynomial α ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ d, 0 ≤ c.coeff d)
    (h : p = c + ∑ i, q i ^ 2)
    (x : α → ℝ) (hx : ∀ a ∈ c.vars, 0 ≤ x a) :
    0 ≤ MvPolynomial.eval x p := by
  rw [h, map_add, map_sum]
  apply add_nonneg (x2611_15512_thm2_1_aux1 c hc x hx)
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => by simp only [map_pow]; exact sq_nonneg _

theorem x2611_15512_thm2_1_aux3 {α R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (A B C D : MvPolynomial α R) (e f : α) (hef : e ≠ f)
    (hAe : MvPolynomial.pderiv e A = 0) (hAf : MvPolynomial.pderiv f A = 0)
    (hBe : MvPolynomial.pderiv e B = 0) (hBf : MvPolynomial.pderiv f B = 0)
    (hCe : MvPolynomial.pderiv e C = 0) (hCf : MvPolynomial.pderiv f C = 0)
    (hDe : MvPolynomial.pderiv e D = 0) (hDf : MvPolynomial.pderiv f D = 0) :
    x2611_15512_rayleigh_difference
      (A + MvPolynomial.X e * B + MvPolynomial.X f * C +
        MvPolynomial.X e * MvPolynomial.X f * D) e f = B * C - A * D := by
  classical
  simp only [x2611_15512_rayleigh_difference, map_add, MvPolynomial.pderiv_mul,
    MvPolynomial.pderiv_X_self, MvPolynomial.pderiv_X_of_ne hef,
    MvPolynomial.pderiv_X_of_ne (Ne.symm hef), hAe, hAf, hBe, hBf,
    hCe, hCf, hDe, hDf, mul_zero, zero_mul, add_zero, zero_add, one_mul,
    MvPolynomial.pderiv_one]
  ring

theorem x2611_15512_thm2_1_aux4 {α R : Type*} [CommRing R] [DecidableEq α]
    (A : Finset α) (e : α) :
    MvPolynomial.pderiv e (∏ a ∈ A, (MvPolynomial.X a : MvPolynomial α R)) =
      if e ∈ A then ∏ a ∈ A.erase e, MvPolynomial.X a else 0 := by
  classical
  induction A using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert a A ha ih =>
    by_cases hea : e = a
    · subst e
      simp [ha, ih]
    · simp [Finset.prod_insert, ha, ih, hea, Ne.symm hea,
        Finset.erase_insert_of_ne (Ne.symm hea), mul_ite]

theorem x2611_15512_thm2_1_aux5 {α : Type*} [Fintype α]
    (P : Set α → Prop) (E : Set α) (hP : ∀ A, P A → A ⊆ E)
    (e : α) (x : α → ℝ) (hx : ∀ a ∈ E, 0 ≤ x a) :
    0 ≤ MvPolynomial.eval x
      (MvPolynomial.pderiv e (x2611_15512_set_polynomial P)) := by
  classical
  simp only [x2611_15512_set_polynomial, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro A hA
  rw [x2611_15512_thm2_1_aux4]
  split_ifs with heA
  · simp only [map_prod, MvPolynomial.eval_X]
    apply Finset.prod_nonneg
    intro a ha
    exact hx a (hP _ (Finset.mem_filter.mp hA).2 (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase ha))
  · simp

theorem x2611_15512_thm2_1_aux6 {α : Type*} [Fintype α]
    (P : Set α → Prop) (e f : α) (hP : ∀ A, P A → ¬ (e ∈ A ∧ f ∈ A)) :
    MvPolynomial.pderiv e (MvPolynomial.pderiv f
      (x2611_15512_set_polynomial P)) = 0 := by
  classical
  simp only [x2611_15512_set_polynomial, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro A hA
  rw [x2611_15512_thm2_1_aux4]
  split_ifs with hfA
  · rw [x2611_15512_thm2_1_aux4, if_neg]
    intro heA
    exact hP _ (Finset.mem_filter.mp hA).2
      ⟨Finset.mem_of_mem_erase heA, hfA⟩
  · simp

theorem x2611_15512_thm2_1_aux7 {α : Type*} [Fintype α]
    (M : Matroid α) (e f : α) (hdep : ¬ M.Indep ({e, f} : Set α))
    (x : α → ℝ) (hx : ∀ a ∈ M.E, 0 ≤ x a) :
    0 ≤ MvPolynomial.eval x (x2611_15512_rayleigh_difference
      (x2611_15512_set_polynomial M.IsBase) e f) := by
  have hz := x2611_15512_thm2_1_aux6 M.IsBase e f (by
    intro A hA hefA
    exact hdep (hA.indep.subset (by
      intro a ha
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at ha
      rcases ha with rfl | rfl
      · exact hefA.1
      · exact hefA.2)))
  simp only [x2611_15512_rayleigh_difference, hz, mul_zero, sub_zero, map_mul]
  exact mul_nonneg
    (x2611_15512_thm2_1_aux5 M.IsBase M.E (fun _ h => h.subset_ground) e x hx)
    (x2611_15512_thm2_1_aux5 M.IsBase M.E (fun _ h => h.subset_ground) f x hx)


theorem x2611_15512_thm2_1 {α : Type*} [Fintype α]
    (M : Matroid α) (hrank : M.eRank = 3) (e f : α)
    (he : e ∈ M.E) (hf : f ∈ M.E) (hef : e ≠ f)
    (x : α → ℝ) (hx : ∀ a ∈ M.E, 0 < x a) :
    0 ≤ MvPolynomial.eval x (x2611_15512_rayleigh_difference
      (x2611_15512_set_polynomial M.IsBase) e f) := by
  classical
  have H :
      (∀ (N : Matroid α), x2611_15512_simple N → N.eRank = 3 →
        ∀ (u v : α), u ∈ N.E → v ∈ N.E → u ≠ v →
        N.closure ({u, v} : Set α) = {u, v} →
        ∃ (c : MvPolynomial α ℝ) (q : α → MvPolynomial α ℝ),
          (∀ d, 0 ≤ c.coeff d) ∧
          (∀ a ∈ c.vars, a ∈ N.E) ∧
          x2611_15512_rayleigh_difference
            (x2611_15512_set_polynomial N.IsBase) u v = c + ∑ a, q a ^ 2) ∧
      (∀ (N : Matroid α), N.eRank = 3 →
        ∀ (u v : α), u ∈ N.E → v ∈ N.E → u ≠ v →
        N.Indep ({u, v} : Set α) →
        ∀ (y : α → ℝ), (∀ a ∈ N.E, 0 < y a) →
        ¬ (x2611_15512_simple N ∧ N.closure ({u, v} : Set α) = {u, v}) →
        ∃ (N' : Matroid α) (y' : α → ℝ),
          N'.eRank = 3 ∧ N'.E.ncard < N.E.ncard ∧
          u ∈ N'.E ∧ v ∈ N'.E ∧ (∀ a ∈ N'.E, 0 < y' a) ∧
          MvPolynomial.eval y' (x2611_15512_rayleigh_difference
            (x2611_15512_set_polynomial N'.IsBase) u v) ≤
          MvPolynomial.eval y (x2611_15512_rayleigh_difference
            (x2611_15512_set_polynomial N.IsBase) u v)) := by
    constructor
    · clear M hrank e f he hf hef x hx
      -- Wagner's coefficient certificate for a simple rank-three matroid
      -- with a closed distinguished pair. The square roots are unnecessary:
      -- q_a is one half of the quartic certificate's quadratic factor.
      sorry
    · clear M hrank e f he hf hef x hx
      -- One reduction step: delete a loop, merge a parallel class by adding
      -- its weights, or delete a third point on the distinguished line.
      -- Wagner Lemma 3.3 gives the last step's monotonicity.
      sorry
  obtain ⟨hcert, hstep⟩ := H
  have hall : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ (N : Matroid α), N.E.ncard = n → N.eRank = 3 →
      ∀ (u v : α), u ∈ N.E → v ∈ N.E → u ≠ v →
      ∀ (y : α → ℝ), (∀ a ∈ N.E, 0 < y a) →
      0 ≤ MvPolynomial.eval y (x2611_15512_rayleigh_difference
        (x2611_15512_set_polynomial N.IsBase) u v) := by
    intro n
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h n ih =>
      intro N hn hr u v hu hv huv y hy
      by_cases hind : N.Indep ({u, v} : Set α)
      · by_cases hgood : x2611_15512_simple N ∧
            N.closure ({u, v} : Set α) = {u, v}
        · obtain ⟨c, q, hc, hcvars, hid⟩ :=
            hcert N hgood.1 hr u v hu hv huv hgood.2
          exact x2611_15512_thm2_1_aux2 _ c q hc hid y
            (fun a ha => (hy a (hcvars a ha)).le)
        · obtain ⟨N', y', hr', hsmall, hu', hv', hy', hle⟩ :=
            hstep N hr u v hu hv huv hind y hy hgood
          have hlt : N'.E.ncard < n := by simpa [hn] using hsmall
          exact (ih N'.E.ncard hlt N' rfl hr' u v hu' hv' huv y' hy').trans hle
      · exact x2611_15512_thm2_1_aux7 N u v hind y (fun a ha => (hy a ha).le)
  exact hall M.E.ncard M rfl hrank e f he hf hef x hx
